name: Dahalokely
isnote: Described as an abelisauroid (Farke and Sertich 2013); Gianechini et al. 2020 cited in the article treat related forms as furileusaurians.
sum: Turonian abelisauroid from northern Madagascar, discovered in 2007 near Antsiranana.
